parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time). The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed 7 days. Default value: the last 24 hours.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time). The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. This parameter is used for exact match filtering.
